status: frozen before any protocol-v3 model prediction, hidden-case authorship, public-session run, or formal scaling/fault run
motivation: Protocol v3 addresses the known protocol-v2 limitations: no matched uncompiled backbone, purposive rule selection, specification/test co-design, synthetic-only event fields, and a one-rule one-project canonical systems run.
known_before_freeze: all protocol-v1 and protocol-v2 datasets, predictions, analyses, and installed-path measurements
the protocol-v2 paper draft and its stated limitations
the PAW manifests identify Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B with runtime qwen3-0.6b-q6_k as the local interpreter

matched_backbone.status: confirmatory addition on already frozen protocol-v1 and protocol-v2 cases

inference.prompt: the same disclosed full-SPEC plus exact-input direct-judge prompt used by the open-model baseline runner
inference.parser: the complete stripped response must be exactly one of OK, INFO, WARNING, or CRITICAL
inference.repeat_rule: run twice from fresh model construction and report whether prediction bytes are identical; retain both attempts if not identical

named_contrasts: PAW standard minus direct matched Qwen3-0.6B
PAW finetuned minus direct matched Qwen3-0.6B
matched_backbone.latency_rule: compare latency only if quantization, runtime, hardware, call boundary, and batching are identical; otherwise report it without a cross-system speed claim

source.project_identity_limit: the source exposes a project field rather than an owner/repository slug; one-per-project claims refer to this exact corpus field

selection.one_record_per_project: within each exact project value, choose the row with the lexicographically smallest lowercase hex SHA-256 of seed + NUL + 'record' + NUL + project + NUL + id
selection.project_order: sort chosen rows by lowercase hex SHA-256 of seed + NUL + 'project' + NUL + project, then project, then integer id
selection.stopping_rule: screen complete fixed-order batches until at least 24 adjudicated eligible records exist; choose the first 24 eligible in fixed project order; if all 399 are exhausted, report the achieved count and do not replace exclusions purposively
selection.screening_independence: screeners work from separate packets and cannot inspect any model prediction
selection.disagreement: a third author adjudicates eligibility before the selected rule set is revealed
eligibility: the record contains one independent behavioral obligation or one atom can be extracted without changing its meaning
the complete observable signal is one scalar field of exactly one supported Codex trigger
a verdict can be made from that field without hidden transcript, filesystem, artifact, task-outcome, or multi-event state
both a compliant and violating field value are plausible
the record and extracted atom contain no secret or personal data

authorship_separation.rotation: for each rule, specification author, hidden-case author, and blind label adjudicator are distinct roles; roles rotate across rules
authorship_separation.specification: exactly four visible examples: two OK and two finding-level examples; the specification author may not inspect hidden cases or predictions
authorship_separation.deterministic_baseline: written from source atom, declared field, and frozen specification only; maximum 20 active minutes per rule; may abstain; source and author choice are frozen before hidden-case authorship
authorship_separation.routed_system: the specification author chooses deterministic or PAW before hidden-case authorship; this routing choice is frozen and scored without revision
authorship_separation.hidden_cases: one separate case author writes eight contrast pairs per rule from the source atom and declared field without seeing specification examples, deterministic source, routing choice, or predictions
authorship_separation.labels: two non-case authors independently label shuffled exact fields from the source atom and declared field while blind to intended polarity and predictions; disagreements are retained and adjudicated
authorship_separation.failed_contrasts: retain every case even when the adjudicated label disagrees with its author's intended polarity
authorship_separation.human_evidence_rule: agent-generated or agent-screened material must be labeled as such and must never be described as independently human-authored

systems: frozen rule-specific deterministic baseline including abstentions
primary_metrics: mean across fixed selected rules of positive-class F1
mean across fixed selected rules of full-label exact accuracy
secondary_metrics: per-rule F1 and exact accuracy distribution
active authoring minutes and source lines for deterministic rules
raw screening and labeling agreement plus Cohen kappa

uncertainty.method: hierarchical resampling of rules, then complete pairs within each sampled rule
uncertainty.named_tests: within-pair exact-correctness label swaps for the two PAW-versus-matched-base contrasts and routed-system-versus-best-single-system contrast, Holm adjusted
uncertainty.population_limit: uncertainty is conditional on the pinned source corpus and eligibility protocol; do not claim private-repository prevalence

repository_uniform_heldout.freeze: publish selection code, screening decisions, rule atoms, specifications, deterministic baselines, routing choices, and a SHA-256 commitment to hidden cases before any system sees a hidden field

public_codex_field_replay.status: confirmatory if completed without privacy exclusions after the study begins; otherwise report as incomplete
public_codex_field_replay.rules: the first eight eligible rules in the repository-uniform fixed order
public_codex_field_replay.environment: fresh sandboxed checkout of a pinned public repository commit with a public task prompt
public_codex_field_replay.sampling: retain every matching exact hook field up to 30 per session; above 30, retain the 30 smallest SHA-256 ranks of session id + NUL + event id before annotation and report the sampling fraction

annotation.adjudication: retain individual labels and one adjudicated label

primary_metrics: fraction resolvable from the declared field
exact accuracy on adjudicated resolvable fields
positive precision and false alerts per session
public_codex_field_replay.recall_gate: report recall and F1 inferentially only if at least 20 adjudicated positive resolvable fields occur across the complete fixed session set
secondary_metrics: sessions with at least one actionable finding
instruction-present versus instruction-removed agent behavior as a secondary paired description
public_codex_field_replay.claim_limit: do not call the observed rate natural population prevalence and do not claim RAP improves agent task success because RAP is non-blocking

scaling_fault_offline.rules: the first 1, 2, 4, or all 8 frozen protocol-v2 external PAW finetuned programs in source-manifest order
scaling_fault_offline.accounting_unit: every expected rule evaluation, including OK outcomes, not only stored findings
metrics: event-to-first and event-to-last expected evaluation p50, p95, and p99
queue-drain seconds and evaluations per second
missing, duplicate, unexpected, and wrong-project evaluations and findings
recursive daemon and worker RSS and CPU
ledger, database, WAL, and audit-log byte growth
marginal resource change per rule and project

cases: daemon termination before and after acknowledgement
inference worker termination while idle and mid-inference
SQLite transient lock or persistence failure
duplicate delivery within the documented window, after expiry, and across restart
deployment or compilation failure while an older revision is active
outcomes: fail-open hook exit code, stdout contract, and latency
current-event survival conditional on acknowledgement boundary
time and events to healthy recovery

scaling_fault_offline.offline_probe: after all required base and adapter files are prepared, run a fixed replay with outbound TCP/UDP connections denied while local Unix sockets remain available; compare prediction bytes with the online-prepared replay and state the exact enforcement boundary
scaling_fault_offline.claim_limit: query-visible evaluation latency excludes Codex asynchronous scheduling, rendered UI latency, and human perception

usability.status: materials may be prepared, but no participant recruitment or data collection is authorized by this protocol alone
usability.start_gate: obtain and record the required Waterloo/Harvard human-subjects determination before recruitment
usability.design: counterbalanced within-subject review tasks comparing raw event/rule records with RAP Findings and Inspector, plus authoring/refinement tasks with hidden cases
usability.claim_limit: an authors-only pilot is interface debugging, not usability evidence

claim_gates.matched_compilation_gain: say a PAW compiler improves over the matched base only if the preregistered paired 95% interval excludes zero in the positive direction
claim_gates.repository_uniform_coverage: report the exact screening yield regardless of magnitude; use broad or substantial only if the Wilson lower 95% bound is at least 0.25
claim_gates.repository_uniform_accuracy: use accurate only for a system with macro positive-class F1 at least 0.80 and hierarchical-bootstrap lower bound at least 0.75
claim_gates.public_replay_recall: make a recall claim only when the complete fixed study contains at least 20 positive resolvable fields
claim_gates.scaling_reliability: say lossless or isolated only for matrix cells with zero missing, duplicate, unexpected, and cross-project records across all declared repetitions
claim_gates.offline_runtime: describe only the exact network-denial boundary actually enforced
claim_gates.usability: make no human-usability claim without the recorded institutional determination and completed protocol

failure_and_rerun_policy.hidden_data: never tune, edit, exclude, or selectively rerun from hidden-case disagreements or predictions
failure_and_rerun_policy.model_runs: run every prepared system once on the complete hidden set; the matched-base second run is the only predeclared prediction repeat
failure_and_rerun_policy.preparation_failure: a compiler or model preparation failure marks that entire system unavailable until a dated amendment; no partial score
failure_and_rerun_policy.infrastructure: retain every attempted formal cell/session; rerun a complete cell only for a harness failure identified independently of system output and record both attempts
failure_and_rerun_policy.bug_fix: if a correctness bug changes data, prompts, parsing, expected accounting, or predictions, publish a dated protocol amendment before a new formal run and preserve superseded artifacts
failure_and_rerun_policy.missing_human_inputs: report the affected study as not completed; do not replace required human judgments with agent output while retaining a human-independence claim
failure_and_rerun_policy.gpu_partition: all formal watgpu jobs must request Slurm partition ALL and manifests must verify it

publish: all released cases and individual/adjudicated labels after scoring
every complete output including invalid predictions
paper_priority: public Codex field replay if complete
protocol-v2 purposive and single-rule studies as supporting or appendix evidence
